It covers the break on an expired snooze filter, which stops the loop. It gives the 45-minute default from SIGNAL_DEFAULT_DEDUP_WINDOW_MINUTES and says that default applies only when the signal has no filters, even if the only filters are snooze filters. It also notes that the filter_signal docstring still says 1 hour. It treats per-filter windows as seconds, with a column default of 3600 and a Pydantic default of 600. It leaves out the mismatch with the UI's minute labels, which is a minor gap. Its canary handling matches the reference: canaries can be snoozed, are never deduplicated or used as dedup targets, and never open a case. I found no false statements. Its extra points, that the filter path does not check for a non-null case_id and that the default path picks the newest instance, are plausible and do not contradict the reference.
